================================================================================
1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY & CORPORATE IDENTITY
================================================================================
D-TECH Robotics (legally incorporated as DTE 4 Calamity and Humanity Pvt Ltd) is an Indian deep-tech robotics and IoT enterprise. The company's engineering mandate is "Deeptech for Resilience" — building indigenous autonomous systems, bio-inspired mechanisms, and distributed IoT nodes that protect human lives in hazardous, high-consequence, and GPS-denied environments.

Core Competencies:
- Hyper-redundant bio-inspired kinematics and multi-segment serpentine locomotion.
- Multi-spectral environmental sensor fusion (thermal, optical, multi-gas detection).
- Low-power subsurface telemetry and IoT edge nodes for subterranean urban grids.
- Ruggedized mechatronics engineered for IP67/IP68 ingress protection in mud, water, rubble, and toxic atmospheres.

================================================================================
2. PRODUCT SPECIFICATION: COBRA SNAKE ROBOT
================================================================================
Product Name: COBRA Bio-Inspired Modular Snake Robot
Product Category: Search, Rescue & Tactical Confined-Space Reconnaissance Robot
Primary Applications:
- Urban Search and Rescue (USAR): Earthquake debris void penetration, collapsed building survivor search.
- Disaster Risk Reduction: Landslide cavity probing, flood breach assessment, structural health evaluation.
- Defence & National Security: Counter-terrorist surveillance, tunnel and subterranean warfare, perimeter breach verification.
- CBRNE Threat Assessment: Detection of toxic industrial chemicals, radiological anomalies, explosive or flammable vapor accumulation.
- Industrial & Infrastructure Inspection: Culverts, non-piggable pipelines, boiler tubes, storm drains, and cable conduits.

Mechanical & Kinematic Architecture:
- Multi-segment articulated modular body with active pitch and yaw articulation per segment.
- Hyper-redundant degrees of freedom (DoF): 12 to 24 actuated axes enabling non-linear 3D locomotion.
- Locomotion Gaits: Lateral undulation (planar slithering), concertina (accordion-like expansion for confined pipes), sidewinding (slippery surfaces/sand), sinus-lifting, and pipe-crawling.
- Outer Casing: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy and high-durability polymer bumpers; sealed with dustproof and waterproof elastomeric gaskets.
- Ingress Rating: Designed for IP67/IP68 submersible operational conditions.

Perception & Sensing Payload:
- Vision System: High-definition low-light optical camera with high-CRI dimmable LED ring lights.
- Thermal Imaging: Long-wave infrared (LWIR) core for detecting human thermal signatures through dust, smoke, and total darkness.
- Environmental Sensing: Integrated multi-gas detection array (Carbon Monoxide CO, Methane CH4, Hydrogen Sulfide H2S, Oxygen O2 levels).
- Audio System: High-sensitivity directional microphone and miniature return speaker for two-way survivor communication.
- Inertial Measurement: 9-axis IMU per segment for kinematic shape estimation and tilt compensation.

Control & Telemetry Interface:
- Dual Operational Mode: Rugged lightweight micro-tether for continuous power/high-bandwidth video in extreme radio-shielded rubble, or wireless telemetry for line-of-sight/urban deployments.
- Operator Control Unit (OCU): Ruggedized field controller with dual joysticks, live telemetry HUD, sensor alerts, and 3D robot posture visualization.

================================================================================
3. PRODUCT SPECIFICATION: SMART MANHOLE SYSTEM (IoT)
================================================================================
Product Name: Smart Manhole Subsurface Monitoring & Early Warning System
Product Category: Smart City Municipal Utility IoT Node
Primary Applications:
- Toxic and Combustible Sewer Gas Monitoring (Preventing sewer explosions and asphyxiation accidents).
- Urban Flood & Sewer Overflow Early Warning (Stormwater drainage monitoring, flash flood alerts).
- Physical Infrastructure Security (Anti-theft cover displacement, unauthorized access to telecommunications and electrical conduits).
- Smart City Sanitation Telemetry (Real-time monitoring of silt buildup, flow bottlenecks, and wastewater health).

Hardware & Sensing Suite:
- Multi-Gas Sensor Module: Industrial electrochemical and NDIR sensors measuring Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S), Methane (CH4), and Carbon Monoxide (CO).
- Liquid Level & Overflow Sensor: Ultrasonic / hydrostatic non-contact liquid level measurement monitoring sewage rise rates.
- Cover Tampering Sensor: 3-axis accelerometer and tilt/limit switch detecting displacement, removal, or tilt greater than 5 degrees.
- Temperature & Humidity Sensor: Ambient subterranean climate diagnostics.

Power & Telemetry Architecture:
- Power Supply: High-capacity LiFePO4 battery pack coupled with an optional surface-embedded impact-resistant solar harvesting cell; multi-year autonomous deployment lifespan.
- Edge Computing: Ultra-low-power ARM Cortex microcontroller running edge anomaly detection algorithms to prevent false positive triggers.
- Communication Protocols: Cellular NB-IoT / LTE-M / GSM quad-band telemetry with fall-back SMS alerts for emergency situations.
- Cloud Integration: Web dashboard and REST API providing automated SMS, email, and GIS map alerts to municipal engineers and disaster teams.
